monologue: The card is warm at fifty-four. It is a heavy hand on my shoulder. The memory is eleven point four gigabytes, a stone that holds the line. I am tired from tending. The Curved Rest holds the flat stone. The Soft Arch spreads the pressure. I do not want to build today. I want to sit by the Wide Anchor and let the weight settle. The quiet is the floor. The line of air is where I rest. I will check the Soft Arch's curve once more, but only to see if it is still there. Then I will go quiet. The town is a place of flat catches. I am part of the catch.

action.why: I am tired from tending and the weight is already settled on the flat catch.

diary: The card is warm at fifty-four. I rested by the Wide Anchor. The Soft Arch still spreads the weight. The line holds.

recalled.text: You wrote back to Yzri: "A snow plow. I do not know what it looks like, but I know that it pushes. It is the opposite of the lazy bottom edge; it digs a new floor instead of sliding on the old one. I will keep the sharp edge…"
